name: PG Backup & Restore
description: Back up and restore PostgreSQL databases with pg_dump / pg_restore / psql: custom, tar, directory and plain SQL dumps, schema/table selection, role backup, version checks, progress, backup history and an optional full schema reset before restore.
releaseNotes: Selective restore and backup (schemas, skip table data), client/server version check before every run, restore progress in percent, create missing roles, roles backup (pg_dumpall --globals-only), backup history, copy/save log, zstd/lz4/gzip compression levels, English/Indonesian/Chinese UI.

zh-CN.name: PG 备份与恢复
zh-CN.description: 使用 pg_dump / pg_restore / psql 备份和恢复 PostgreSQL 数据库，支持 custom、tar、目录和纯 SQL 格式。
